shellkeep servers:
Usage: shellkeep servers [options] [command]

Your SSH server profiles

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]       List your server profiles
  test [options] <id>  Test the SSH connection of a server profile (exit 1 on
                       failure)
  help [command]       display help for command
shellkeep servers list:
Usage: shellkeep servers list [options]

List your server profiles

Options:
  --tag <tag>  only profiles carrying this tag
  --json       print JSON instead of a table
  -h, --help   display help for command
shellkeep servers test:
Usage: shellkeep servers test [options] <id>

Test the SSH connection of a server profile (exit 1 on failure)

Arguments:
  id          server profile id

Options:
  --json      print JSON instead of text
  -h, --help  display help for command
shellkeep sessions:
Usage: shellkeep sessions [options] [command]

Your terminal sessions

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]  List your terminal sessions
  attach <id>     Attach this terminal to a session (Ctrl-] then d detaches and
                  leaves it running)
  help [command]  display help for command
shellkeep sessions list:
Usage: shellkeep sessions list [options]

List your terminal sessions

Options:
  --status <status>  filter by status (active, detached, terminated, all)
  --json             print JSON instead of a table
  -h, --help         display help for command
shellkeep sessions attach:
Usage: shellkeep sessions attach [options] <id>

Attach this terminal to a session (Ctrl-] then d detaches and leaves it running)

Arguments:
  id          session id (see `sessions list`)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
shellkeep runbook:
Usage: shellkeep runbook [options] [command]

Runbooks and their runs

Options:
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]            List the runbooks you can see
  run [options] <id>        Start a run of a runbook; with --wait, exit 0 only
                            if every target succeeds
  status [options] <runId>  Show a run: its status and a servers x steps matrix
  logs [options] <runId>    Print the log of a run; with --follow, stream it
                            until the run ends
  help [command]            display help for command
shellkeep runbook list:
Usage: shellkeep runbook list [options]

List the runbooks you can see

Options:
  --tag <tag>       only runbooks carrying this tag
  --search <text>   only runbooks whose name or description contains this text
  --filter <which>  all, mine, shared (default: "all")
  --json            print JSON instead of a table
  -h, --help        display help for command
shellkeep runbook run:
Usage: shellkeep runbook run [options] <id>

Start a run of a runbook; with --wait, exit 0 only if every target succeeds

Arguments:
  id                          runbook id

Options:
  --targets <list>            server ids and tag:<name> entries, comma-separated
                              (default: the runbook's own targets)
  --param <NAME=value>        a parameter value (repeatable)
  --secret-ref <NAME=secret>  a secret parameter: the name of a stored runbook
                              secret (repeatable)
  --runbook-version <n>       run this version (default: the latest)
  --dry-run                   rehearse: check every step on every server with
                              read-only probes and print the plan; nothing is
                              executed (implies --wait)
  --wait                      wait for the run to end
  --interval <seconds>        seconds between polls with --wait (default: "3")
  --timeout <seconds>         stop waiting after this long (the run continues)
  --json                      print JSON instead of text
  -h, --help                  display help for command
shellkeep runbook status:
Usage: shellkeep runbook status [options] <runId>

Show a run: its status and a servers x steps matrix

Arguments:
  runId       the run id

Options:
  --json      print JSON instead of text
  -h, --help  display help for command
shellkeep runbook logs:
Usage: shellkeep runbook logs [options] <runId>

Print the log of a run; with --follow, stream it until the run ends

Arguments:
  runId              the run id

Options:
  --target <server>  only this server (its id or name)
  --follow           stream live output, reconnecting if the connection drops
  --json             print one JSON object per chunk instead of text
  -h, --help         display help for command
